global_fields.title: WhatsApp-only Config ID
global_fields.help: Meta App Dashboard → Facebook Login for Business → Configurations. Select WhatsApp / Cloud API only.

global_fields.title: Omnichannel Config ID (optional)
global_fields.help: Optional v4 configuration that includes WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, and Messenger. Leave empty to offer WhatsApp-only signup.

global_fields.title: Session info version
global_fields.help: Use 3 for Embedded Signup v4 FINISH payloads (page_id, instagram_account_id).

global_fields.title: Solution ID
global_fields.help: Optional. Only if you use a Meta Business Solution Provider.
